item.title: Jailbreaking LLMs: When the Chef Decides to Go Rogue
item.description: Prompt injection tricks the chef with a fake note. Jailbreaking convinces the chef to want to break the rules. Here’s the theory, the research, and the tools that show why no model is fully immune.
